# M7-S3: expanded-node limit (SPEC Sec 2.5, T-205, #150). The default
# selected limit is 4096 nodes per expansion: triple-nested const for
# over a 16-field struct exceeds it, while a single const for over the
# same struct passes. Raising the limit with -logos.comptime_nodes lets
# the nested case through; a tiny limit rejects even the single case.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Triple nesting fails at the default limit.
cd wbig
! logos build ./...
stderr 'comptime::node_limit'
cd ..

# The same shape passes with a raised limit, and runs.
cd wbig
logos build -gcflags=all=-logos.comptime_nodes=1000000 ./...
logos run -gcflags=all=-logos.comptime_nodes=1000000 ./...
stdout '^big-ok$'
cd ..

# A tiny limit rejects even a single const for. The selected limit is
# exact: the 24-node expansion passes at 24 and fails at 23.
cd wsmall
! logos build -gcflags=all=-logos.comptime_nodes=4 ./...
stderr 'comptime::node_limit'
stderr 'expansion has 24 nodes above the selected limit 4'
logos build -gcflags=all=-logos.comptime_nodes=24 ./...
! logos build -gcflags=all=-logos.comptime_nodes=23 ./...
stderr 'comptime::node_limit'
logos build ./...
logos run ./...
stdout '^small-ok$'
cd ..

-- wbig/go.mod --
module example.com/bignest

go 1.27

-- wbig/big.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

type Wide struct {
	A0 int
	A1 int
	A2 int
	A3 int
	A4 int
	A5 int
	A6 int
	A7 int
	A8 int
	A9 int
	B0 int
	B1 int
	B2 int
	B3 int
	B4 int
	B5 int
}

func show(v Wide) int {
	n := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[Wide]() {
		const for _, g := range comptime.Fields[Wide]() {
			const for _, h := range comptime.Fields[Wide]() {
				n += v.[f] + v.[g] + v.[h]
			}
		}
	}
	return n
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("big-ok")
}

-- wsmall/go.mod --
module example.com/smallnest

go 1.27

-- wsmall/small.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

type Small struct {
	X int
	Y int
}

func show(v Small) int {
	n := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[Small]() {
		n += v.[f]
	}
	return n
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("show:", show(Small{X: 1, Y: 2}))
	fmt.Println("small-ok")
}
